pages.text: 2026 marked year of growth for AUSL Skip to Content The second season of the Athletes Unlimited Softball League concluded over the weekend, with the Utah Talons and superstar pitcher Montana Fouts repeating as league champions . However, that hardly signals that things were the same in the AUSL in 2026 as they were a year ago. The league added two expansion teams (Portland and Oklahoma City), played in dedicated markets for the first time, saw widespread increases in fan interest and made history in softball broadcasting. Commissioner Kim Ng acknowledged the league needed to “prove” itself when it began 15 months ago. Those things helped do just that, in addition to capitalizing on a general “thirst” for softball fans over the past few years. A thrilling season on the field with several breakout stars helped, too. “I think, quite convincingly, we are bringing on more fans who have not really even seen the game of softball,” Ng said in a postseason press conference Wednesday. “So really happy about those moments.” ATHLETES UNLIMITED SOFTBALL LEAGUE Talons win second straight AUSL title Everything to know about AUSL All-Star Cup Complete AUSL coverage Jon Patricof, CEO and co-founder of Athletes Unlimited, said Game 1 of the 2026 AUSL Championship Series -- which aired on ABC -- was the first ever professional softball game on broadcast television. pages.text: 2027 Women's World Cup: Northern Ireland and Republic of Ireland learn play-off routes - BBC Sport Image source, Getty Images/Press Eye Image caption, Northern Ireland and the Republic of Ireland both face tricky play-off ties in their bid to reach the World Cup By Andy Gray BBC Sport NI Journalist Published 18 June 2026 Northern Ireland face a difficult 2027 Women's World Cup play-off with Portugal, while the Republic of Ireland will take on Kazakhstan. Michael McArdle's side will be underdogs against Portugal, who beat NI twice in Euro 2025 qualifying. If they can win that game, then either Iceland or Croatia await in the second round of play-offs. Given their play-off ranking, even if Northern Ireland could stun two of Europe's biggest sides they could still face an additional inter-continental play-off to make it to the finals in Brazil. The Republic of Ireland, who qualified for a first World Cup in 2023, will face a first round tie with Kazakhstan. pages.text: 3 generations of women show how choices on having kids changed : NPR Accessibility links Skip to main content Keyboard shortcuts for audio player 3 generations of women show how choices on having kids changed In one family, three generations of American women explore how choices around becoming mothers have changed at the same time the U.S. birth rate has dropped. 3 generations of women in one family show how choices on motherhood have changed January 28, 2026 5:00 AM ET By Sarah McCammon , Avery Keatley Caroline Brown (left) and Cynthia Briscoe Brown look at family photo album with their grandmother and mother Barbara Briscoe (seated) in Atlanta. Nicole Buchanan for NPR hide caption toggle caption i Nicole Buchanan for NPR American women today are having fewer children than their mothers and grandmothers did. They also have more opportunities and life choices. "I don't really feel like I got strong messages about what my life should look like beyond college graduation," said Caroline Brown, 33, of Charlotte, N.C.. "I was very much under the impression that the world was kind of my oyster." Like a growing number of younger women, she's unsure if she wants children. And she's not unusual; the U.S. birthrate now is about half of what it was in the 1960s. Caroline's grandmother, Barbara Briscoe, 93, says during her childbearing years, there wasn't a big question about what she was going to do with her life. Learn everything you can Treatment options, blood sugar highs and lows, carb counting , ketones, dealing with sick days , managing diabetes at school . Read books, join support groups and online forums, talk to your child's health care team and other parents. pages.text: 3,000 hits club in MLB Skip to Content The 3,000-hit club is one of the most famous, and one of the most exclusive, in all of baseball. The players who have gotten 3,000 hits in the Major Leagues are few and far between. They are legends of the game -- nearly all of the 33 members are Hall of Famers or soon-to-be Hall of Famers. Here is every member of the 3,000-hit club, listed in chronological order of when they got their 3,000th hit, starting with the most recent. Miguel Cabrera 3,000th hit: April 23, 2022 (Single) Team: Tigers Career hits: 3,174 Cabrera punched a single into right field against the Rockies' Antonio Senzatela for his 3,000th hit in front of his home crowd at Detroit’s Comerica Park, making him the 33rd player to reach the milestone. The two-time AL MVP and Triple Crown winner became the first Venezuelan player and seventh Latin American player to reach 3,000 hits. Cabrera also joined another, even more exclusive club with the knock, becoming the seventh player to record 3,000 hits and 500 homers. Hank Aaron, Willie Mays, Eddie Murray, Rafael Palmeiro, Albert Pujols and Alex Rodriguez preceded Cabrera in achieving both feats. pages.text: 3,000 Strikeout Club Skip to Content Only the greatest pitchers in Major League history have reached 3,000 strikeouts. The 3,000-K club got its newest member on July 2, 2025, when Clayton Kershaw became the 20th pitcher to record 3,000 strikeouts . Pitching at Dodger Stadium in front of the only home crowd he’s ever known in the Majors, Kershaw’s 3,000th strikeout in his final season represented another milestone mark for a pitcher who is all but assured a first-ballot election to the Hall of Fame. • Photos: 3,000-strikeout club Max Scherzer was the most recent pitcher to reach the milestone before Kershaw, recording his 3,000th career K in 2021 and getting to 3,500 in June 2026 . Justin Verlander, who joined the 3,000-K club in 2019, notched his 3,500th career strikeout on Aug. 10, 2025. Here's a look at the 20 pitchers in MLB's 3,000-strikeout club, ranked by their career strikeout totals. (Totals through 2026 season.) 1. Nolan Ryan: 5,714 strikeouts Ryan took over as MLB's all-time strikeout leader on April 27, 1983, when he passed Walter Johnson with No. 3,509. Then he struck out 2,205 more batters before his career was over. The Ryan Express is the only Major Leaguer in the 5,000-strikeout club -- he reached that milestone by striking out a fellow Hall of Famer, Rickey Henderson, on Aug. 22, 1989. In his career, Ryan led his league in strikeouts 11 times, and he struck out more than 300 batters in a season six times. pages.text: 30-30 club broken down by team Skip to Content The marvel of the 30-30 club is predicated on the rare combination of speed and power it takes to swipe 30 bases and bash 30 homers in the same season. A record seven players joined the club in 2025: Juan Soto , Jazz Chisholm Jr. , José Ramírez , Corbin Carroll , Francisco Lindor , Pete Crow-Armstrong and Julio Rodríguez . PCA became the first player to join the club in 2026, making it two straight seasons for the Cubs superstar, and Washington's CJ Abrams and Cincinnati's Elly De La Cruz joined the party later in the year. The feat has been pulled off 82 times in AL/NL history. Here is a team-by-team breakdown of the 30-30 club, ranked in order from the team with the most 30-30 seasons to the least -- there are actually six teams that have never had someone pull off the feat. (Note: We list franchises together, even if the club moved.) Mets: 8 Francisco Lindor, 2025 (31 HR, 31 SB) Juan Soto, 2025 (43 HR, 38 SB) Francisco Lindor, 2023 (31 HR, 31 SB) David Wright, 2007 (30 HR, 34 SB) Howard Johnson, 1991 (38 HR, 30 SB) Howard Johnson, 1989 (36 HR, 41 SB) Howard Johnson, 1987 (36 HR, 32 SB) Darryl Strawberry, 1987 (39 HR, 36 SB) After never stealing more than 12 bases in a season, Soto shockingly joined the 30-30 club for the first time in his first season with the Mets. Lindor added his second 30-30 season with the Mets in 2025 after doing so in '23. In the process, Lindor and Soto became the third pair of teammates with 30-30 seasons in the same year.
